safe_cex_transport::signing::RemoteSigne.reason: Reviewed signing.rs: the default ignores its typed HttpSigningRequest and returns TransportError::Host refusing native query signing. It reads no raw input and produces no decoded value. TS createRemoteSigningAdapter has no such refusal, so every production signer must override it: the registry HostSigner (native_account.rs, witnessed by tests/native_account_methods.rs hosted_signer_signs_native_query_requests) and binance TransportSigner forward it to the host.
